# GloCAB cropland field boundaries (Brazil, Canada, Russia, Ukraine, USA)

GloCAB field boundaries (2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from University of Maryland. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/latest/glocab.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: geometry, determination:datetime, predominant_crop, region, metrics:area, no_area, admin:country_code, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/collection.json
